t: This is St Paul's Bow Common, an Anglican church at the junction of Burdett Road and St Paul's Way. It replaced an earlier church of 1858, designed by Rohde Hawkins, which was largely destroyed in the Second World War and demolished in the 1950s. The new church was designed by Robert Maguire, a modernist architect and a leading thinker in the Church of England's liturgical architecture movement. St Paul's Bow Common has been voted the best church of the twentieth century in the United Kingdom.
